### Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed to Participate in Virtual Headquarters Visit with Wells Fargo


August 27, 2026


Download PDF Format (opens in new window)


IRVING, Texas


, Aug. 27, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE: CAT) CEO Joe Creed is expected to participate in a virtual headquarters visit and moderated investor discussion hosted by Jerry Revich of Wells Fargo on Thursday, Sept. 10 from 9 to 9:45 a.m. CDT.


A real-time video[webcast](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759326-1&h=784625458&u=https%3A%2F%2Fteams.microsoft.com%2Fl%2Fmeetup-join%2F19%253ameeting_ZDFmYjMwMTQtMmEzOC00N2ViLThlZWYtZmE0NjIxNzc3YjVl%2540thread.v2%2F0%3Fcontext%3D%257b%2522Tid%2522%253a%2522ceb177bf-013b-49ab-8a9c-4abce32afc1e%2522%252c%2522Oid%2522%253a%2522d6c7f4bc-fb7f-4cee-8e9e-4560be6858e1%2522%257d&a=webcast) will be available to the public. Participants should visit the website at least 15 minutes before the live event to download and install any necessary software. A transcript, audio and video will be posted afterward on Caterpillar's investor relations website,[https://investors.caterpillar.com/events-presentations/default.aspx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759326-1&h=2172458442&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.caterpillar.com%2Fevents-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.caterpillar.com%2Fevents-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx) .


**Phone Call-In Information:** +1 312-270-1925
Conference ID: 733 843 428#


**About Caterpillar**
For more than a century, Caterpillar has built a better, more sustainable world. With 2025 sales and revenues of $67.6 billion, Caterpillar Inc. is shaping the future as the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. Backed by one of the largest independent global dealer networks and financing services through Cat Financial, the company's primary business segments: Power & Energy, Construction Industries and Resource Industries are solving customers' toughest challenges through commercial excellence and advanced technology, driven by a highly skilled, dedicated global team. Learn more at[www.caterpillar.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4759326-1&h=1850831019&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caterpillar.com%2F&a=www.caterpillar.com) .
